Hi Alice —

Appreciate the note. We can accommodate a lighter cadence that still covers SOC 2, DPA mapping, and pen-test coordination. Proposal below (rolling 30-min segments):

- Day 1 morning (UTC friendly): three 30-min segments back-to-back
  - Segment A (30m): Infra & network controls (Ops + vendor readout)
  - Segment B (30m): Application & data protections (App eng + engineering leads)
  - Segment C (30m): Evidence mapping + legal Qs (Legal + Evidence owner)

- Day 2 (if needed): one 60-min consolidation for legal and exec Qs

Pros: keeps ops in short focused windows and lets legal have the single consolidation slot they want. We can shift the vendor readout to the start of Segment A if their availability is limited to mornings.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- July 6: 08:30–10:00 PT (three 30-min segments 08:30/09:00/09:30)
- July 7: 08:30–09:30 PT (fallback consolidation)

Please confirm timezone preference (PT vs. UTC) and whether the vendor needs to attend the whole first 30-min or only the first 10–15 minutes.

What we need from you beforehand:
- Evidence index (mapping of control -> artifact) — PDF or spreadsheet
- A main point of contact during the sessions for clarifying scope
- For pen-test overlap: vendor contact + high-level window constraints

I've attached a short draft agenda (agenda-30min-segment.md) with timeboxes and a suggested owner list. We can iterate on it.

Next steps: pick one of the July slots above and tell us who will join each short segment. I can create calendar invites and a single meeting bridge for both days.
